name: FLA_LEASE_DETAILS_HIST
description: FLA_LEASE_DETAILS_HIST contains the history of FLA_LEASE_DETAILS.

columns.name: LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease detail history identifier. This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VERSION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Version type code. Any lease would have a minimum of one and a maximum of two versions. Possible values are "D" for Draft version, "F" for Final version and "H" for History version.

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the lease. This indicates the number of versions the lease has undergone.

columns.name: LEASE_VERSION_NAME
columns.description: Lease version name, It is a short identifier of the version.

columns.name: AMORTIZATION_END_DATE
columns.description: Date till which the amortization has to be considered.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Feeder system from which lease data was created.

columns.name: COMMENCEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the lease commenced or amendment commenced.

columns.name: TERMINATION_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the lease is inactive.

columns.name: LEASE_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the lease version. Possible values are Finance Lease, Operating Lease or Exempt Lease.

columns.name: LEASE_VERSION_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Lease version description on what changes or amendments has been brought into the lease.

columns.name: APPROVAL_COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments or details provided by the user who has approved the lease version.

columns.name: APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Lease approval status. A draft lease or an amendment goes through different statuses before being finalized.

columns.name: APPROVED_BY
columns.description: Name of the user who has approved the lease draft or Amendment to mark it as final.

columns.name: APPROVED_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the lease or amendment was approved.

columns.name: EXECUTION_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the transaction is booked. It indicates the day on which the lease is being executed.

columns.name: PRIM_REGIME_ADDER_RATE
columns.description: Adder rate which is used for the primary regime.

columns.name: PRIM_REGIME_DISC_RATE_INDEX_ID
columns.description: Discount rate index that is used for the primary regime.

columns.name: PRIM_REGIME_INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Discount rate index value that is used for the primary regime.

columns.name: RESPONSIBLE_USER
columns.description: Name of the user responsible for the lease creation.

columns.name: SECD_REGIME_ADDER_RATE
columns.description: Adder rate which is used for the secondary regime.

columns.name: SECD_REGIME_DISC_RATE_INDEX_ID
columns.description: Discount rate index that is used for the secondary regime.

columns.name: SECD_REGIME_INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Discount rate index value that is used for the Secondary regime.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: GENERATED_BY
columns.description: Name of the user who has generated the schedules and payments.

columns.name: GENERATED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the schedules and payments were generated.

columns.name: VALIDATED_BY
columns.description: Name of the user who has validated the lease.

columns.name: VALIDATED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the lease was validated.

columns.name: SUBMITTED_BY
columns.description: Name of the user who has submitted the lease for approval.

columns.name: SUBMITTED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the lease was submitted for approval.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction type which identifies which transaction is being executed. Various values could be BOOKING, TERMINATION, AMEND, RESCIND

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction sub type. Possible values are SCOPE_INCREASE, SCOPE_DECREASE, SCOPE_NO_CHANGE, EDIT and so forth for a REVISION transaction type.

columns.name: PERCENTAGE_OF_REDUCTION
columns.description: Reduction in ROU or Liability. This would be based on reduction in time, usage or liability.

columns.name: VERSION_PREPARED_BY
columns.description: Name of the user who has prepared the version.

columns.name: VERSION_SIGNED_DATE
columns.description: Date the version is signed on during an amend.

columns.name: VERSION_INITIATED_BY
columns.description: Name of the user who has initiated the version.

columns.name: VERSION_INITIATED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the version was initiated.

columns.name: SCHEDULES_REFRESH_NEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the schedules need to be refreshed or not.

columns.name: LEASE_AMENDMENT_NOTES
columns.description: Notes captured as part of amendment.

columns.name: FINAL_LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Final lease detail record identifier. This identifies the final record from the main table for this record.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REPORT_JOB_ID
columns.description: Report request identifier of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REPORT_JOB_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REPORT_JOB_RUN_DATE
columns.description: Date the report job was launched.

columns.name: QUARTZ_RUN_DATE
columns.description: Date the quartz process started the scheduling.

columns.name: QUARTZ_JOB_NAME
columns.description: Functional name of the quartz job.

columns.name: QUARTZ_JOB_GROUP
columns.description: Group associated with quartz job.

columns.name: PROCESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROCESS_JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROCESS_JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OPTION_TRANSACTION_CODE
columns.description: Option type selected during an amendment in case the amendment is for exercise or cancel of an option.

columns.name: TERMINATION_TRANSACTION_CODE
columns.description: Termination type selected during termination. Value could be ASSET or LEASE.

columns.name: APPROVAL_SUB_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Approval sub status indicates the lease version sub status when the version is in working status.

columns.name: LEASE_TERMINATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the lease is getting terminated or not.

columns.name: AUTO_FINALIZE_VERSION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the lease should be auto finalized along with validation and generation of schedules.

columns.name: INCREASE_ACCOUNTING_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the contingent increase amount accounting treatment for the amendment. Possible value would be Contingent Increase and Non Contingent Increase.

columns.name: INCREASE_IMPACT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the lease is impacted by payment increase agreement.

columns.name: INCREASE_GENERATED_BY
columns.description: Name of the user who has submitted the generate payment increase action.

columns.name: INCREASE_GENERATED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the lease was submitted for generate payment increase action.

columns.name: BALANCE_SYNC_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the job that created or last updated the row. This is used for request created for the purpose of lease balances.

columns.name: BALANCE_SYNC_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates if the balances were synced for this lease.

columns.name: LEASE_TRX_APPROVAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the lease approval is enabled for the lease version.

columns.name: PROCESS_REQUEST_CODE
columns.description: Captures the request details executed on the lease.

columns.name: AMEND_FOR_INDEX_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the amendment is for finalization of assessments which are for index based agreements.

columns.name: PRIM_REGIME_SCOPE_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Scope change method for leases in primary accounting standard. Values can be Unit based percentage and Liability based percentage.

columns.name: SECD_REGIME_SCOPE_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Scope change method for leases in secondary accounting standard. Values can be Unit based percentage and Liability based percentage.

columns.name: LEASE_SECONDARY_CLASSIF_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the secondary classification of the lease. Possible values are Finance, Operating and Exempt.

columns.name: REQUIRE_PROPERTY_DEFN_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to Indicate if a property is required for the assets on the expense lease.

columns.name: INTEREST_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Interest method. Possible values are DAILY and PERIODIC COMPOUND.

columns.name: ARREARS_PAY_DT_TREATMENT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment due date is included in day count calculation for the present value derivation when the payment is in arrears. Possible values are Beginning of the day and End of the day.

columns.name: APPROVAL_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Indicates the transaction identifier generated for lease approvals.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
